indexingNote: Published pages that have made no indexing decision: neither listed in sitemap.xml nor carrying <meta name="robots" content="noindex">. On a GitHub Pages PROJECT site robots.txt cannot help — the crawler reads the USER site's robots.txt in another repository, and Disallow blocks crawling rather than indexing, which stops a noindex tag from ever being seen. The tag is the only thing that works. Recorded 2026-08-22; shrinking this list belongs to the page's owner. Anything not listed here fails the gate.

indexing.why: the staff scheduling dashboard's front page, public and neither listed nor noindex. app/robots.txt already says this in its own comment — the re-engagement tool carries the tag and this does not. A staff surface showing rosters and attendance should carry noindex; behind a sign-in would be better still, since neither robots.txt nor a meta tag is a security control
the page the dashboard actually runs, same position as its index.html and same remedy

iconsNote: Published pages with no <link rel="icon">. A browser given none asks for /favicon.ico on every load and gets a 404; this site ships app/favicon.svg, which a browser only finds when a page points at it. The four pages that are team-owned or Rensley's were fixed on 2026-08-22; these four are in other lanes and are one line each for their owner. This list is meant to SHRINK.
